infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Livia AI needs camera access so you can photograph rice crop leaves for disease diagnosis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Livia AI needs microphone access so you can record voice questions in English or Kannada.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Livia AI needs photo library access so you can attach crop leaf photos for diagnosis.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Livia AI to access your photos to select rice crop images for diagnosis.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Livia AI to access your camera to capture rice leaf photos.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Livia AI to access your microphone for voice queries in English and Kannada.
